result.summary: The page is largely functional and well-structured. One notable visual issue was identified related to a discount badge displaying an unusual value.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which is an unusual and potentially erroneous value. A 100% discount would imply the item is free, which is likely a data or display error rather than an intentional promotion.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value being passed to this card component. Add validation to cap discount display values at a reasonable maximum (e.g., 99%) or ensure the backend returns correct promotional data.
